description: Where are Hyperliquid's most profitable accounts positioned? Reads the open positions of the top 20 accounts by day, week, month or all-time P&L. For a coin: long vs short notional and account counts, size-weighted average entry per side, share of open interest, the biggest holders, and where their liquidation prices cluster above and below mark. Without a coin: the coins with their largest net exposure. Live; not advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

coin.description: A Hyperliquid perp symbol such as BTC, ETH, HYPE; leave out for the top coins

window.description: Leaderboard window the top accounts are picked by; default month
